The Trio Banners is select one character for Rate Up. The select one character and their sig works the same as Trio Banner percentages. Its just the guaranteed at 90 is either WoD or Character. Guaranteed to be WoD or character next, if the previous 2 SSRs are the opposite.

2 WoDs = Next is Character
Vice versa
Pity is a whole nother thing. Each “type of banner” has their own pity bar.
Some banners, albeit with different names, share the same pity bar
While others, only with the same name, do they share the same pity bar
The google doc above might tell ya which shares which pity bar. Otherwise, you need to click the bottom left on the banner to see which pity bar is this banner building towards.
